ru.text: Позы: вӣрāсана (16.47) и парйан̇кāсана (22.10) по изданию Тёржёк (часть IV, раздел 14).

en.text: Verse 16.47 places the vīra posture at japa. Verse 22.10 is iconography of the yoginīs; paryaṅkāsana is the editor’s emendation of the manuscripts’ «°āgata». Törzsök interprets paryaṅka as the ascetics’ seated posture, identical with vīrāsana; this is the editor’s interpretation, not the text. Both passages were checked against the edition (pp. 40 and 51; Part IV, section 14).

rows: Азиатское общество Бенгалии, Калькутта, рукопись 5465 (G), 793 г. непальской эры ≈ 1663
